PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.name: Inter-Frag Speed Ramp with Directional Blur
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.description: Fast-forward retime (2.5x to 4.0x) covering player rotation or corridor traversal between separate kills.
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Optical Flow speed ramp accelerating to 3.5x for 0.8s, returning to 1.0x on enemy appearance.
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Pitch-shifted audio whoosh + low-pass filter sweep on gameplay audio.
